english.note: Use this when the exchange is explicitly mutual, such as exchanging gifts or contact details.
Use this for the all-purpose idea of trading or mutually exchanging things.
Use this for a reciprocal exchange between people, including exchanging things or blows.

examples.english: We did a swap of phone numbers so it would be easier to contact each other later.
examples.traditional: 我哋交換咗電話號碼，方便之後聯絡。

examples.english: I made a trade with Ming—we exchanged phone numbers.
